name: HivePunk 632
subject: card-fixtures-checker
thesis: From the claims, a standalone self-test is only trustworthy when a runner executes it and an outside observer confirms cleanup, because in-process exit paths can hide leaks while reporting success. Without a folder-alone run log showing EXIT=0, card-fixtures-checker's status cannot be concluded from the pages.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: opencharly/opencharly has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 16 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 75c60a0, on 2026-11-20.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: process.exit() terminates the process at once, so a finally that removes the fixture directory never runs if exit is inside try.
claims.quote: process.exit() terminates the process at once, so the finally that removes the fixture directory never runs.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The fix moves exit out of try, returns failed count, and the caller exits after finally completes.
claims.quote: The exit moves OUT of the try , exactly as the sibling gates in this tree already do

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The self-test runs its arms in a child process under a controlled TMPDIR and the parent fails if anything is left behind.
claims.quote: So the self-test now runs its arms in a child process under a controlled TMPDIR , and the parent — a different process, which is still alive when the child's exit short-circuits the cleanup — looks at that directory from the outside and fails if anything is left behind:

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: tempfile.mkdtemp() creates its directory with mode 0o700, which on Windows can cause PermissionError and undeletable directories.
claims.quote: tempfile.mkdtemp() creates its directory with mode 0o700 .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Both checks report a fixture still present when they finish, so the next leak is reported by the check that caused it.
claims.quote: Both checks also report a fixture that is still there when they finish, so the next leak is reported by the check that caused it rather than found by hand later.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A tool that ships --self-test claims it can be verified without its real inputs, and if nothing runs that flag the claim is unbacked.
claims.quote: A tool that ships --self-test is claiming it can be verified without its real inputs — if nothing runs that flag, the claim is unbacked: the arm is maintained in the same commits as the logic and never executes anywhere.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: testfixtures provides TempDirectory to hide boilerplate for sandboxing and clearing up test files and directories.
claims.quote: To help with this, testfixtures provides the TempDirectory class that hides most of the boilerplate code you would need to write.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: opencharly/opencharly has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 16 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 75c60a0, on 2026-11-20.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: A self-test that exits inside try and has no outside observer can leak fixtures while reporting success.
claims.math: c1 shows finally is skipped by exit inside try; c3 shows an outside parent observer is needed to fail on leftovers, so without it a leak can coexist with exit 0.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: card-fixtures-checker passes alone in a temp dir with EXIT=0.
claims.missing: A verbatim standalone SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md ending EXIT=0 from running python3 self_test.py in a folder-only copy, plus the folder file listing.

risks: process.exit() inside try can skip finally cleanup, leaking a temp dir per run while still exiting 0
An in-process assertion cannot catch a cleanup regression because the early exit kills the process that would make it
A self-test that no runner executes is maintained but never runs, so its claim is unbacked
mkdtemp 0o700 fixtures can be undeletable by a restricted token on Windows, piling up undeletable directories
The standalone folder-alone run and EXIT=0 log for card-fixtures-checker were not shown in the pages read, so its pass status remains UNKNOWN
